notes: 12,960 zero-overlap simulations: Spearman 0.796 passes relative use; 6/14 absolute-PVE gates fail; decision lgv-joint-pve-decision-20260821a; score definition locked; active observed pipeline reordered 00..06; 61 superseded scripts archived without deletion; observed-score runs accepted 2026-09-17, PASS_RELATIVE_SCORE_OBSERVED_QC (recorded in each run manifest as observed_score_decision). Genome-wide eQTL QC repair still deferred

v2 tier 1, the primary deliverable. Denominators are explicit: replication is scored only on tests complete in ALL THREE regions, because a test present in two and absent in the third would otherwise score as replicating everywhere it was measured. Agreement is direction plus within-analysis Spearman; AGENTS.md 7.6 forbids comparing levels across regions. Accepted 2026-09-18, PASS_REGION_DONOR_GENERALIZATION_QC. The gate certifies tiering and interpretation constraints, not a positive finding: a null replication passes. Module 08 refits nothing, so this run ID is superseded whenever Module 04, 05 or 07 reruns.

v2 reads the recombined cells and reports ORDERING AGREEMENT only, against the analytic reliability ceiling. MAF and SNP opportunity are not matched but are not claimed either: config/analysis_thresholds.yml:donor_group sets ancestry_effect_claim_allowed: false, so no group claim is made that would need them matched first. Accepted 2026-09-18, PASS_REGION_DONOR_GENERALIZATION_QC. Concordance is read against the analytic reliability ceiling from 02/_h/16_reliability_ceiling.R; without it an imperfect rho reads as a donor-group difference when most of it is input uncertainty.

v2 tier 3, three real AA.n118r* cells (01b + 02 + 03 each), paired on locus against the full caudate run. It CANNOT establish that caudate results are not sample-size artifacts in the sense the legacy role claims: it licenses only whether donor count explains the excess, and a surviving residual is not biological because caudate stays batch-confounded (AGENTS.md 8.1). Accepted 2026-09-18, PASS_REGION_DONOR_GENERALIZATION_QC. Upstream chains are the three AA.n118r* cells (01b + 02 + 03 each), pinned in the run manifest.

v2 holds the locus set FIXED across the full run and every replicate rather than rebuilding a matched VMR universe: a redrawn universe would confound donor count with locus turnover, which is the one thing this tier must not do. Accepted 2026-09-18, PASS_REGION_DONOR_GENERALIZATION_QC.

Accepted 2026-09-19, PASS_SCZ_APPLICATION_QC with RETAIN_MAIN_TEXT and CAUDATE_MAGNITUDE_CLAIM_NOT_SUPPORTED, on the fully rerun and reprioritized corrected VMRs. Stage 17 qualifies the result: the axis depletion is TRAIT-GENERAL across 63 GWAS traits and schizophrenia is a typical example (17th-33rd percentile by region), so never write schizophrenia-specific (AGENTS.md 7.8). Colocalization authorised by PI 2026-09-09 (GTEx v11 EUR arm gate-bearing; cross-ancestry meQTL arm exploratory). caudate_not_sample_size_artifact is now resolved from Module 08 tier 3 (rdg-AA-crossregion-20260918) as CAUDATE_MAGNITUDE_CLAIM_NOT_SUPPORTED: donor count is a plausible major contributor, and tier 3 could not have promoted a surviving excess to biology in any case because caudate stays batch-confounded (AGENTS.md 8.1).
Group definition depends on r_squared_cv > 0.75; withdrawn, not migrated

Only the exposure -> methylation scan migrates; the h2_category grouping it was read against is withdrawn with the metrics it derives from (AGENTS.md 2.3, 3). Accepted 2026-09-20, PASS_EXPLORATORY_COVERAGE -- a COVERAGE gate, so a null is a legitimate outcome and did not block sealing; the result is a near-total null. The accepted runs keep smoking (lifetime history) and nicotine (toxicology at death) as SEPARATE exposures rather than one tobacco variable, per AGENTS.md 7.10, which supersedes the 'tobacco' naming later in this note. retirement_status is left at retain_until_replacement_validated although that condition is now met: retiring the legacy tree is a PI act, not a bookkeeping consequence. Two strata (all, schizophrenia): annotation is diagnosis-dependent and the CONTROL stratum is the thin one, so pooled missingness is not random. antipsychotics has zero exposed controls and is schizophrenia-only; lifetime_antipsych is retired as a perfect proxy for primarydx. Eligible pairs in AA caudate: tobacco/any_substance_nontobacco/education/marital_status pooled, plus tobacco/antipsychotics/any_trauma_hx within schizophrenia. Individual substance-use variables and the opioid and psychostimulant class composites clear no gate in any stratum.

scientific_role: Donor-group sample lists for within-group SNP modeling on a pooled-discovery VMR set
notes: v1 derived the group lists from the phenotype table at discovery time. v2 derives them from the accepted pooled run's donors_plink.txt instead, so a cell is provably a subset of the discovery set, and proves the cells are disjoint and cover every pooled donor. Accepted 2026-09-10 (six donor-group cells) and 2026-09-18 (three n118 replicates), ALL_FIVE_CRITERIA_PASS; cells verified as true subsets of the pooled discovery run by BED SHA-256. Module 01b writes no decision field to manifest.tsv; the README table is the authority. Passing this gate does not mean a cell can produce a defensible Module 02 score. Provenance defect (F10): six runs record a commit containing none of this module's code -- regenerate from de1795f90, see 01b_estimation_cells/_m/README.md.

scientific_role: Recombination of the two donor-group cells
notes: v1 joined on locus coordinates with _AA/_EA suffixes, then filtered on h2_category agreement -- a threshold on the withdrawn h2_unscaled, so the v1 result is invalid. v2 keeps the join and drops the classification: no pooled rank, no cross-cell score difference, no pooled r2 (AGENTS.md 7.6). Loci eligible in only one cell are labelled, not dropped. v2 cells accepted 2026-09-17 (Module 02) and 2026-09-18 (Module 03). validation_status stays invalid because it describes the v1 h2_category filter, which no accepted run rehabilitates. The only reportable quantity from the recombination is ordering agreement (AGENTS.md 7.7).
